found_by_this_closeout: R13-N01 -- the ampacity coverage clause read its RULING requirement out of env['rails_A'], a presentation dict in which every float has been through round(x, 4).  The true ACC_3V3_SW fault ceiling is 0.80486138 A, the display copy says 0.8049 A, and a design current equal to the true ceiling was reported STALE against its own value.  Rounding a requirement moves it UP as often as down.

R13-N02 -- C-ACC-ILIM-01 was named eight times in the canonical model as a measurement of record and existed NOWHERE as a step a technician executes.  It exists now, and F12 requires every measurement_of_record any tagged primitive names to appear in the first-article procedure.

R13-N03 -- the ST25R3916 IC identity register could be ASSERTED rather than merely reported the moment the datasheet premise was corrected: DS12484 Rev 3 Table 117 gives ic_type4..0 = 0b00101 at address 3Fh, so a wrong part in that socket now fails the probe instead of reading 'alive'.  The die revision is still reported, not asserted.

R13-N04 -- DEVICE_SPEC carried U12's compound worst case as 1.9702 A with a 'NAMED THIN MARGIN of 29.8 mA'.  Both are RETIRED: the fault-coincidence case is 2.2069 A, ABOVE TI's guaranteed 2 A output, and is accepted on the device's own switch-current limit instead.  The CONFORMING worst case, 1.8020 A, is what is inside the guaranteed output.  F6 already ruled on the corrected basis; the document did not say so.

convergence_architecture.charger_control_loops: SYS_REG, CC_PATH_LIMITED, ILIM, VINDPM, DPPM, NO_CHARGE, SUPPLEMENT -- rebuilt from SLUSF65B 6.3.1/6.3.2/6.3.3/6.3.5/6.3.6 with battery-tracking VINDPM, the VBSUP1/VBSUP2 hysteresis band and explicit mode history.  Every ceiling question is asked at seven points of the declared threshold sweep and both histories and answered by the worst.
convergence_architecture.gauge_conversion_age: ADI 19-6171 Rev.7: VCELL is the AVERAGE OF FOUR conversions updated every 250 ms, so the post-load window is 4 x 250 = 1000 ms.  GaugeLoadEpoch records the last material load edge and the ONE production gauge reader spends the remainder of the window before every permission and retention read.  Nothing else clears the epoch -- not an ACK, not a qualification, not a successful read.
convergence_architecture.independent_domain_construction: the oracle DECLARES the product's domain and CONSTRUCTS the key multiset it expects -- 32 permission rows, 24 named transitions, each exactly once, every live state contributing network rows, the rejection set matched as a multiset.
convergence_architecture.normative_values_are_generated: ten semantic scan families over five documents; the mode-indexed permission table is EMITTED into two documents; the fab notes' delivery voltages and thermal figures are derived; every measurement_of_record must be a first-article step.
convergence_architecture.one_source_of_truth: duplicated raw/summary state fields are EQUALITY-GATED; the declared pair is ONE OBJECT gated by identity; the ILIM band has one primitive authority that F6 and audit_rail_ampacity both call.
convergence_architecture.provenance_is_semantic: every GUARANTEED_* primitive must name its document and row in GUARANTEED_ROWS, repeat both tokens in its own source, state a CONDITION, carry no widening and not declare itself.
convergence_architecture.retained_state_reconciliation: CC1101 SRES/SIDLE + MARCSTATE, SX1262 SetStandby + GetStatus, and ST25R3916 Set default + Operation control read-back.  An unconfirmed NFC field refuses accessory power BY NAME and HOLDS the burst slot on U9's behalf.
